reviewSummary: The draft records g21-fixture-corpus.v19 as G21 leftover-design per-D-002-platform copies of the D-335 prefix-one-over-posthandshake injection, after D-336, on last-heading custody only. I re-resolved every custody claim it makes from live bytes rather than accepting the dispatch: the subject digest and mode, HEAD, the COORD and file 08 digests, all four corpus digests, all six Stage A review digests, both Stage A return shapes field by field and type by type, both predecessor verdicts and all six named finding identifiers, the four fixture copies' bytes and paths, the G10 and G23 platform arrays, five live file-08 figures, twenty cited COORD headings, D-272's CONTESTED suffix, and the untouched D-319 drafts. Everything re-resolves true. The entry keeps every boundary the dispatch fences: no row SATISFIED, no gate SATISFIED, no Class A opened, no QUALIFIED pin, OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING left open on g21 leftover-join.v17, the copies' staleness deferred rather than measured, leftover-join.v17 unremasured, v17 and v18 left frozen and unrecorded, fixtures/g21.v15/ unmoved, no Windows copy, no invented identifier or platform list, and D-319 neither invented as a heading nor overwritten. The wording carries no deictic version reference, no bare version token and no predecessor-voiced disclaimer. I found nothing to charge at either grade.
decision: CONSENT — 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-two attacks run, twenty-two refuted from bytes; every cited digest, mode, commit, heading, cell token, review shape, finding identifier and fixture byte re-resolves true against live state.
observations: The Decision's Class-A non-opening sentence names DR-117 and DR-G21, where D-336's named DR-117, DR-114 and DR-G21. This matches D-335, the fixture-corpus sibling, whose sentence reads identically to this one. Silence about DR-114 Class A is not an assertion about it, and DR-114 is separately covered by an explicit 'Does not SATISFY DR-114' in both the header and the Decision. Not charged.

The status block's shorthand '(0 blockers, 0 SHOULD-FIX)' uses the branch's standing ACCEPT-0/0 phrasing, identical to D-336's. Claude's Stage A carries no blockers field at all; the disposition table says so explicitly one screen below, so the shorthand cannot be read as inventing one. Not charged.

The successor's findingDisposition.claudeV18M1 describes the landing as 'basedOn.predecessorV15.role Findings land at g21-fixture-corpus.v16', which reads oddly for a v18 finding. That is the successor's internal repair-log wording, not the draft's claim, and it is out of scope for this review of the entry. The draft's own landing statements are the ones I verified, and both hold.
fixtures/g21.v16/ is untracked in git at review time, consistent with a candidate dispatch. The draft makes no claim that it is committed.
residualObservationsNotCharged: The Subject compresses the successor's authorityClaim, which spells out that G21 occupancy v4 has no platforms array and therefore requires independently pinned implementations on every D-002 platform. The compression loses no boundary: the Subject still names the quoting source, the four tokens and the ORDERED-EQUAL relation. Not charged.

The Decision's 'no same-id ROW twin' clause restates the closure condition rather than measuring it. As a rationale for leaving OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING open it is conservative in the safe direction and asserts no new fact. Not charged.
